target_profile.system_boundary: Captured HashiCorp raft Go library; no external implementation or historical report used. Main role loop, per-peer replication, FSM worker and snapshot worker are owned here; stores, transport and FSM are supplied interfaces with in-repository implementations still within audit scope.

activities.purpose: Qualified support for decision formation and legal advancement
activities.realization_summary: Leaders persist and replicate indexed entries; voter match quorum after startIndex advances commitment. Followers validate prefix and consume propagated commit index.

activities.purpose: Context validity and acquisition, transfer or loss of authority
activities.realization_summary: Term-based elections use configured voter replies, persisted votes and log freshness. Lease and higher-term paths end authority; each leader owns fresh aggregation. VerifyLeader separately gathers reply support.

activities.purpose: Recovery and resynchronization of eligible participation
activities.realization_summary: Constructor loads state; replication backs off to matching prefix or installs a snapshot and resumes.
Latest/committed configuration indexes coordinate serialized changes; voter suffrage drives election and commitment while all members receive replication.
processLogs queues selected committed commands to a dedicated FSM worker; future result follows worker application.

activities.purpose: History, persistence and reconstruction of support
activities.realization_summary: Injected LogStore, StableStore and SnapshotStore hold term, votes, logs and snapshot/configuration. In-repository storage implementations have not yet been read, and are not declared externalized.

activities.purpose: Client contracts, invocation intervals and observed completion
activities.realization_summary: Apply/Barrier enqueue through role loop; futures expose completion or error. VerifyLeader is offered to avoid stale reads after authority loss.

behaviors.execution_owner: Raft main loop and one vote RPC goroutine per eligible peer
behaviors.protocol_context: A candidate attempt, current term, latest configuration
behaviors.trigger: Follower contact timeout or a renewed candidate attempt
implementation_guards: Only latest-configuration voters are solicited and may campaign; pre-vote normally precedes persisted election term.
Vote receiver rejects old terms, ineligible candidates, less up-to-date logs and conflicting persisted same-term votes. Known-leader check has a leadership-transfer exception.
writes: Current term, role, leader address; last vote term and candidate
durable_effects: Term is stored before publishing; a granted real vote follows persistVote.
async_boundaries: Each attempt owns a buffered reply channel. Later attempts do not consume prior attempt replies.
important_branches: A greater reply term causes follower transition. Timeout starts a new attempt. Nonleaders reject client writes and verifies.

cross_activity_effects.A1: A successful voter tally enables a fresh leader commitment object; log freshness constrains what history the new leader can advance.

behaviors.trigger: Entry to and exit from runLeader
writes: Fresh commitment, inflight list, replication map and stepDown channel
external_effects: Dispatches a current-term no-op; voter contact lease failure steps down.
On exit closes peer stop channels, responds ErrLeadershipLost to retained inflight/verify futures and clears leader state.
async_boundaries: Old replication goroutines retain their old commitment and stepDown references; new leadership allocates new objects.

cross_activity_effects.A1: Old reply accounting cannot directly populate the new commitment object; startIndex gates commitment on a current-term entry.
cross_activity_effects.A7: Loss of leadership completes retained pending futures with uncertainty errors.

behaviors.protocol_context: Current leader term and current latest configuration
behaviors.trigger: Accepted apply or configuration change, or leadership no-op
writes: Assigns increasing log indexes and current term; adds inflight futures
durable_effects: Stores logs before matching local server or triggering replication
important_branches: Store failure responds errors and changes role to follower.
external_effects: On success updates lastLog and notifies replicators.

behaviors.execution_owner: Per-peer replication and pipeline decoder goroutines
behaviors.trigger: New log trigger, commit propagation timeout, retry or pipeline reply
implementation_guards: Replication starts at lastIdx+1; failed prefix matching backs nextIndex down.
Only successful responses update match; response term greater than sent term notifies stepDown.
writes: nextIndex and term-local match accounting; contact time
async_boundaries: Pipeline sends and decoder run separately; pipeline errors return to ordinary replication.
external_effects: Carries LeaderCommitIndex separately from the bounded entries batch.
unknowns: Legal histories that might leave a divergent follower suffix beyond a successful bounded AppendEntries request remain to be analyzed.

behaviors.execution_owner: commitment mutex and leader main-loop consumer
behaviors.protocol_context: One leader term, current voter set
behaviors.trigger: Local/remote match update or configuration replacement; commitCh wakeup
implementation_guards: Only voter IDs are kept in matchIndexes. Match increases monotonically.
Median quorum match must reach startIndex and exceed current commitment index.
writes: Commitment index then Raft commitIndex; committed configuration when passed
external_effects: Notifications coalesce; leader reads current commitment and sends committed inflight group for application.

cross_activity_effects.A5: Committed group is sent to processLogs; FSM completion happens later.

behaviors.execution_owner: Main RPC dispatcher; heartbeat fast path for heartbeat-shaped messages
behaviors.protocol_context: Receiving peer term, stored log/snapshot and leader commit index
implementation_guards: Old-term rejection; higher term changes role and persists term.
Previous index/term must match; conflicting incoming entry truncates local suffix.
writes: New log entries, latest/committed configuration, lastLog, commitIndex and contact time
important_branches: On successful append path commitIndex becomes min(LeaderCommitIndex,getLastIndex()) when ahead.
Storage failures return without success; truncated-log StoreLogs failure leaves an explicitly noted lastLog cache concern.
external_effects: processLogs consumes the selected prefix; response success precedes no guarantee of FSM completion.

cross_activity_effects.A2: Accepted newer-term leader traffic ends prior authority.
cross_activity_effects.A5: Schedules commands through selected commit index.

unknowns: Heartbeat dispatch concurrency and transport classifier boundaries require separate examination.
Whether producer/backtracking history makes every retained suffix below LeaderCommitIndex eligible is unresolved.

behaviors.execution_owner: Leader main goroutine and receiver configuration processing
behaviors.protocol_context: Latest and committed configurations, each with log index
behaviors.trigger: Configuration API admitted only when previous configuration and current-term no-op committed
implementation_guards: Stable configuration gate before leader accepts another change.
writes: New configuration changes commitment voter set; replication includes nonvoters.
Receiver rolls latest back on conflicting truncation, and processing a subsequent configuration treats the former as committed.
external_effects: Removed peers get best-effort replication and stop; new peers get a term-specific replicator.

cross_activity_effects.A1: Voter set determines commit aggregation while all members receive history.
cross_activity_effects.A2: Voters determine election/lease quorum; committed local removal ends leadership.

behaviors.execution_owner: Main goroutine processLogs and dedicated runFSM goroutine
behaviors.protocol_context: Committed prefix selected by leader or follower
implementation_guards: processLogs skips indexes already queued; ordered channel carries command/barrier/config tuples.
writes: Raft lastApplied means queued progress; runFSM has separate processed index/term.
external_effects: FSM.Apply or ApplyBatch runs; corresponding futures respond after application.
async_boundaries: Enqueue completion differs from FSM completion; snapshots and restore share FSM worker.

cross_activity_effects.A7: Apply future response is completed by FSM worker after client command application.

behaviors.execution_owner: Constructor, snapshot thread, receiver main loop and FSM worker
behaviors.protocol_context: Persisted log/snapshot and configuration; remote leader term
behaviors.trigger: NewRaft or InstallSnapshot; local snapshot request
implementation_guards: Constructor restores newest usable snapshot, then scans later configuration entries.
Remote install rejects old terms, validates byte count, finalizes snapshot and waits for FSM restore before updating snapshot/configuration state.
Local snapshot requires applied FSM index at least committed configuration index.
writes: Recovered last log, term, snapshot, applied index and configuration
async_boundaries: Snapshot compaction follows persisted FSM snapshot; missing replication logs trigger snapshot send.

cross_activity_effects.A1: Snapshot success gives replicator match at snapshot index; future entries resume after that index.
cross_activity_effects.A2: Restored term/history and configuration constrain future election participation.

unknowns: User-forced restore and manual RecoverCluster have distinct semantics not yet traced.
external_effects: Only the successful sendLatestSnapshot reply path reports snapshot index to the term-local commitment object; constructor and receiver installation do not report a leader match.

behaviors.execution_owner: API caller, role loop and future consumer
implementation_guards: Enqueue timeout and shutdown handling; nonleaders reject.
external_effects: Apply future reports completed application or an error; leadership loss does not tell whether the write survived.
VerifyLeader is documented as checking continued leadership for avoiding stale FSM reads.

cross_activity_effects.A2: VerifyLeader requests a fresh authority check.

behaviors.protocol_context: One verifyFuture and current replication map
writes: Self vote = 1 and quorumSize = voter count/2+1; registers same future in every replicator notify map
external_effects: Requests heartbeats from all replication peers; singleton quorum completes immediately.
unknowns: Why nonvoter replication peers are included in an authority confirmation whose threshold is voter-based.

behaviors.protocol_context: One pending verification and one notifying replicator
behaviors.trigger: notifyAll after heartbeat, successful append/snapshot, or stale-term detection
writes: Drains per-peer notify map; increments unqualified integer votes on positive response
implementation_guards: voteLock serializes tally; notifyCh nil prevents further notifications after completion threshold or negative response.
important_branches: Negative response queues the future without incrementing; positive threshold queues it.

behaviors.protocol_context: Previously initialized verifyFuture returned through verifyCh
external_effects: If votes >= quorumSize, removes pending registrations and responds nil; otherwise changes to follower and returns ErrNotLeader.
existing_protections: Leader exit responds ErrLeadershipLost to still-retained verification futures.

cross_activity_effects.A7: Nil future result is exposed to the caller as successful VerifyLeader.

facts.meaning: For each retained voter ID, the leader-term commitment object records the greatest matched index reported by local storage or that peer replication path.
facts.validity_context: One leadership instance and its currently installed voter set; meaning depends on producer response correctness.
facts.durability: Volatile aggregation; successful producers refer to stored log or installed snapshot.
facts.recovery: Rebuilt empty on every leader entry; established persistent history is rediscovered by replication.

facts.meaning: A verifyFuture carries an integer tally initialized with self support and incremented by positive notifications from registered replication peers; reaching quorum queues it for leader-loop consumption. The tally does not itself encode voter identity or suffrage.
facts.validity_context: Pending verification in one leader instance; notifyCh becomes nil after a decisive notification. Configuration changes during an operation are not yet analyzed.
facts.recovery: Not recovered; retained pending futures are failed on leader exit.

surfaces.reason: The receiver bounds commit by local lastIndex rather than last entry in this request. Producer nextIndex initialization and backwards search may guarantee the unmatched suffix is removed on first success; establish the legal history before testing a fabricated small request.
Code notes stale lastLog after StoreLogs fails following DeleteRange. Fault contract, store failure semantics and future consumers need reading.

Constructor permits concurrent fast path despite handler main-thread comment. Need concrete transport classifier and shared-state synchronization before alleging concurrent authority transition defects.
Separate forced-history APIs identified through API and leader-loop dispatch; caller duties and full implementations not yet traced.

core_overview.rationale: Representative formation and authority paths have been traced together through owners, context changes, persistence, replication, commit consumption and completion. Local history, failure and transport premises remain open rather than claimed covered.

formation.explanation: A leader assigns term/index and stores each entry before self match. Per-peer replicators send bounded batches with previous index/term and leader commit index; rejection backs nextIndex down, missing history sends a snapshot, and successful replies contribute match only to that leader commitment object. Its voter-only median must reach startIndex. The leader loop consumes commitment, updates committed membership and queues ordered entries; followers perform prefix/conflict checks and consume a propagated commit bound. The FSM worker, not enqueue, completes command futures.

context.explanation: Contact loss permits a configured voter to pre-vote and then persist a new term and self vote. Candidate attempts own independent reply channels, solicit voters and tally a majority. Vote receivers enforce eligibility, persisted same-term vote and log freshness; higher-term traffic/replies and voter lease failure end authority. Leader entry creates fresh support objects and a no-op; exit stops replication and fails retained pending work. VerifyLeader is a separate current-authority confirmation path whose peer eligibility needs investigation.

connection.explanation: Prior persistent entries and snapshot state survive leadership changes and constrain elections through last index/term comparisons. Old volatile support is isolated in old per-attempt channels and old commitment objects; a new leader can advance inherited entries only after its current-term startIndex is quorum matched. Membership gates further changes until previous configuration and current-term entry commit, updates voter aggregation, and can remove leader authority. Follower suffix replacement updates configuration context. Recovery reconstructs snapshot/history/configuration before participation; completed decisions flow to FSM and futures independently of later leadership.
